overview: A hopper that keeps a sample in each slot and can shut the slots it is not using, which is a five-item filter made out of a hopper's own rules.

1.0.0: Keep: a slot will not give up its last item, so what is left there stays as a sample.
Off: a slot takes nothing and gives nothing, by hand or by hopper.
One of each item you want through, Keep on, the rest of the slots off, and nothing else can get in.
